summary: Alterity Therapeutics, an Australian foreign private issuer, filed a routine Form 6-K covering September 2026, submitting Exhibit 99.1, an Application for Quotation of Securities (ATH) to the ASX — the Australian equivalent of a US registration or listing notice for newly issued shares. The filing incorporates the exhibit by reference into existing Form S-8 and Form F-3 registration statements. No price, stake, premium, advisor, board recommendation, or transaction terms are stated; Chairman Julian Babarczy signed. This is an ordinary administrative securities-quotation notice, not a special situation. No risk-arb angle applies.
